correctness.rationale: Every pairwise-intersecting family of K_n edges lies in a star or is exactly a triangle. A is the union of n star simplices and equivariantly deformation retracts onto subdivided K_n; adding exactly binom(n,3) triangle 2-cells gives relative C2 identified with Λ³Z^n. Its connecting map is augmentation contraction, surjective over Z onto the graph cycle lattice because triangles through one vertex form its integral basis. The LES then gives integral kernel Λ³ker(augmentation), no torsion or other reduced homology. The generating determinant product of permutation cycles divided by 1+t yields the claimed character. Independently computed character for every permutation of n=4,5,6,7 and compared the formula exactly; this is finite corroboration only.

originality.rationale: The exact claimed statement and implications were compared, not merely titles. The independence complex of KG(n,2) is the complex of pairwise intersecting 2-subsets of [n], equivalently the star–triangle complex of a complete graph. The proof translates equivariant topology to the exterior-power kernel of the complete-graph boundary. Barmak gives the non-equivariant wedge of binom(n−1,3) two-spheres, hence Betti ranks and torsion-freeness, but does not alone identify the integral Sn-action. Analogous Sn-modules for Kneser neighborhood or scale-two Cech complexes are for different simplicial complexes. The full equivariant attaching contraction and isomorphism to Λ³ of the augmentation lattice are additional facts. The known non-equivariant wedge type is acknowledged, not restated as novel. The searches and inspected sections support a bounded best-of-knowledge judgment, not an exhaustive novelty certificate.
